## Manuscript Figures

### Figure 1

Long term climatologies of sea-surface temperature (SST) between (A) 1993 - 2024 and forecasted SST changes under IPCC RCP Scenarios (B) 2.6 and (C) 8.5. The white contour lines represent every 5 degrees °C SST. 

![](images/plot_thetao_glorys_ssp26_ssp85_3panel_growth_rate_full_draft_ms_fig.png)


<br>

### Figure 2
Long term climatologies of sea-surface salinity (SSS) between (A) 1993 - 2024 and forecasted SSS changes under IPCC RCP Scenarios (B) 2.6 and (C) 8.5. The white contour lines represent every 1 unit change in salinity. 

![](images/plot_so_glorys_ssp26_ssp85_3panel_growth_rate_full_draft_ms_fig.png)


<br>


### Figure 3
Predicted distribution of *G.polynesiensis* growth rates (div/day) during (A) 1993 - 2024, and under anticipated ocean warming based on IPCC RCP Scenarios (B) 2.6 and (C) 8.5.

![](images/plot_glorys_ssp26_ssp85_3panel_growth_rate_full_draft_ms_fig.png)

<br>

### Figure 4
Spatial difference in predicted *G.polynesiensis* growth rates (div/day) between (A) IPCC RCP Scenario 2.6 and historic data (1993 - 2024) and (B) IPCC RCP Scenario 8.5 and historic data (1993 - 2024). 

![](images/plot_ssp26_ssp85_diff_btwn_glorys_2panel_growth_rate_full_draft_ms_fig.png)

<br>


### Figure 5
Predicted distribution of total *G.polynesiensis* CTX production (ng/ml/day) during (A) 1993 - 2024, and under anticipated ocean warming based on IPCC RCP Scenarios (B) 2.6 and (C) 8.5.

![](images/plot_glorys_ssp26_ssp85_3panel_CTX_rate_full_draft_ms_fig.png)

<br>

### Figure 6
Spatial difference in total predicted *G.polynesiensis* CTX production (ng/ml/day) between (A) IPCC RCP Scenario 2.6 and historic data (1993 - 2024) and (B) IPCC RCP Scenario 8.5 and historic data (1993 - 2024). 

![](images/plot_ssp26_ssp85_diff_btwn_glorys_2panel_CTX_rate_full_draft_ms_fig.png)

<br>
